title: Coherent partitions of projected Simon superpositions

claim.text: A coherent partition of a projected Simon-type wavefunction exposes whether a logical/geometric partition is aligned with the hidden translation: partitions invariant under x -> x XOR s have zero forbidden Simon mass inside every sector, while transverse partitions can carry forbidden mass sector-wise that cancels only through cross-sector interference when the sectors are recombined.
claim.scope: Finite 4-bit / GF(16)-labelled statevector testbed. The experiment studies projected wavefunctions and coherent partitions, not oracle-query speedup, hardware advantage, biological cognition, or a theorem about arbitrary bundles/manifolds.
assumptions: n = 4 and the hidden nonzero translation s is fixed before projection weights and partitions are measured
the substrate state is the exact Simon coset-entangled state over 16 input labels and 8 quotient labels
projection acts only on the quotient/output register and is postselected mathematically without measurement noise
all compared partitions contain four cells of four computational-basis labels
Walsh-Hadamard is the exact normalized 4-bit transform
forbidden_promotions: no claim that GF(16) is intrinsically superior to an equally aligned non-field partition
no claim of quantum computational speedup or lower circuit complexity
no claim that a partition corresponds to physical spacetime geometry
no claim that sector interference proves the Hypercomplex Brain ontology
no claim of independent witnessing; producer and verifier are the same development line until an external recomputation exists

specification.intended_object: A 7-qubit-equivalent pure substrate state |Psi_s> = (1/4) sum_x |x>|[x]_s>, projected by a normalized quotient-register bra to a 4-qubit pure state |psi_chi>. A partition P={C_alpha} decomposes |psi_chi> into unmeasured sector states |psi_alpha>=P_alpha|psi_chi>. Each sector is Walsh transformed separately before coherent recombination.
invariants: projection consistency: direct pair-weight construction equals explicit substrate-register projection
Simon symmetry: psi[x] = psi[x XOR s]
global forbidden mass L_global = sum_{y: y dot s = 1} |W psi[y]|^2 is zero to numerical tolerance
interference closure: diagonal forbidden mass plus off-diagonal forbidden interference equals L_global
secret-aligned partitions commute with the hidden translation and have zero sector forbidden mass
all partition controls are capacity matched at four cells x four labels
known_answer_cases: GF(4)-additive-coset partition containing s is hidden-translation aligned and must have sector forbidden mass <= 1e-12
a random partition built by grouping complete {x,x XOR s} pairs is also aligned and must have sector forbidden mass <= 1e-12
the unpartitioned projected state must have global forbidden mass <= 1e-12 for every seed
for any partition, forbidden diagonal plus forbidden off-diagonal contribution must reconstruct global forbidden mass to <= 1e-12

implementation.commit: implementation must descend from this preregistration commit, not from the base commit directly
implementation.environment: Python >=3.10, NumPy >=1.24; Qiskit is already a repository dependency but is not required for the exact finite statevector arithmetic in this round
implementation.representation: 16 computational-basis labels identified with GF(16) elements already implemented in aionq.gf_frames; quotient/coset labels are virtual output-fibre coordinates; partitions are explicit disjoint subsets of the 16 projected amplitudes

metric.name: sector_forbidden_mass_with_interference_closure
components: L_global: total Walsh probability on y dot s = 1 after coherent recombination
L_sector: sum_alpha sum_{y dot s = 1} |W psi_alpha[y]|^2
I_off_forbidden: sum_{alpha != beta, y dot s = 1} Wpsi_alpha[y] conj(Wpsi_beta[y])
pair_cut_fraction: fraction of hidden pairs {x,x XOR s} split across partition cells
translation_commutator_defect: normalized Frobenius defect of partition projectors against T_s
equivalence_attacks: random secret-aligned non-field partitions matched in cell count and size
random fully transverse partitions forced to split every hidden pair
random relabellings of the aligned GF(4) partition while keeping the state and secret fixed
all five distinct GF(4)-scaled 2D additive subspaces a*GF(4) when available, so the field family contains both aligned and transverse members rather than one hand-picked geometry

black_box: explicit substrate-register projection equals direct projected-state construction
global Walsh distribution has zero forbidden Simon mass
structural: partitions are disjoint, exhaustive, and exactly four cells of four labels
field partitions are generated from gf16_mul rather than hard-coded expected outcomes
translation alignment is computed independently from the spectral metric
property_based: across deterministic projection seeds, pair symmetry and interference closure hold to 1e-12
every secret-aligned partition has zero sector forbidden mass to 1e-12
metamorphic: global phase of the projected state changes no probability metric
coherently summing all sectors exactly recovers the unpartitioned wavefunction
fuzzing: eight deterministic projection seeds and eight matched random-partition seeds
random aligned and forced-transverse partitions generated independently of the Walsh computation
historical: R1Q/R1R/R1S showed that partition labels and cut transversality can create misleading geometry claims; this round therefore includes relabelling and matched non-field partitions from the start

matched_baselines: FIELD-ALIGNED: GF(4) additive cosets containing s
ALIGNED-RANDOM: random grouping of complete Simon pairs into four cells of four
FIELD-TRANSVERSE: other GF(4)-scaled additive subspace coset partitions not containing s
TRANSVERSE-RANDOM: random four-by-four partitions forced to split every Simon pair
negative_controls: RELABELLED-FIELD: random permutations of the aligned field partition with the state and secret held fixed; any surviving zero leakage must be explained by accidental retained alignment
alignment-only control forbids interpreting FIELD-ALIGNED zero leakage as a field-specific advantage if ALIGNED-RANDOM also gives zero
controls.compute_parity: Every partition evaluates the same 16 amplitudes, four sector Walsh transforms of length 16, and the same metrics; no control receives more statevector samples or optimization.
controls.parameter_parity: not applicable: deterministic finite transform with no trainable parameters
controls.sampling_parity: same eight projection seeds and matched partition-seed count for every stochastic control family
controls.data_access_parity: all controls receive the same projected wavefunction and hidden secret; only the partition changes

preregistration.prediction: P1: L_global <= 1e-12 for every seed and partition. P2: FIELD-ALIGNED and ALIGNED-RANDOM have L_sector <= 1e-12. P3: every forced-transverse partition has L_sector > 1e-8 for every nondegenerate projection seed. P4: for transverse partitions, Re(I_off_forbidden) is negative and cancels L_sector so closure_defect <= 1e-12. P5: field-scaled partitions separate only by whether they contain the hidden translation, not by being field-derived per se.
preregistration.primary_metric: effect region over (pair_cut_fraction, L_sector, Re I_off_forbidden, closure_defect); no scalar winner score
preregistration.uncertainty_method: exact finite arithmetic up to floating-point error plus eight deterministic projection seeds; report per-seed rows, medians, minima, maxima, and no asymptotic inference
preregistration.kill_condition: Kill the structural interpretation if an aligned partition has L_sector > 1e-12, if any forced-transverse partition has L_sector <= 1e-8 on a nondegenerate seed, if global Simon leakage exceeds 1e-12, or if interference closure defect exceeds 1e-12. If FIELD-ALIGNED differs from ALIGNED-RANDOM while both have identical hidden-pair alignment, report representation dependence rather than field advantage.
preregistration.stop_condition: Stop R1T after the projected-state gate, four control families, field-spread comparison, relabelling attack, and interference accounting are reported. Do not add hyper-Walsh, adiabatic, sheaf, holoportation, or higher-cosmos dynamics to rescue or embellish this round.
preregistration.promotion_rule: H -> M only for the finite claim that sector-resolved Walsh interference detects hidden-pair transversality on this 16-state testbed, and only if the preregistered gates pass with raw artifacts committed. CI may establish additional platform reproduction only for jobs that actually finish green; it is not required for the mathematical finite-state result and no cross-platform claim is made from a pending/failed job. Independent witnessing remains unavailable without a genuinely independent recomputation.
